rules.addressing: slot = top log2 bits of corpus_memory._finalise(ctx * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15 + node * 0xC2B2AE3D27D4EB4F), node 1..255 MSB-first bit tree, no tag
rules.update: per training position in corpus order, 8 nodes root first: if n_b == 255 halve both; n_b += 1; if n_other > 2: n_other = n_other // 2 + 1
rules.lookup: miss when root n0 + n1 == 0; greedy path with p(bit) = (n_bit + 0.4) / (n0 + n1 + 0.8), tie -> bit 0; second = best of the 8 one-flip paths (tie -> lowest level)
